objective: Test whether strictly-causal observables independent of slope_t can identify normalization failure zones before any new normalized_strength law is developed.

observable_family.COMMON_VOL_SHIFT: abs(log(peer-median rolling median abs 1-bar log-return over 5 bars / 20 bars))
observable_family.XS_VOL_SHIFT_DISPERSION: MAD across five carriers of log(rolling median abs-return 5/20 ratio)
observable_family.CORRELATION_BREAK: 1 - median pairwise correlation of 1-bar log returns over prior 20 bars
observable_family.SSE50_RELATIVE_VOL_SHIFT: abs(log((000016 rolling median abs-return 5/20 ratio) / peer-median rolling median abs-return 5/20 ratio))

threshold_rule: For each observable, freeze alert threshold at the 80th percentile of its valid causal values in 2025-09/10 reference months; no evaluation outcomes enter threshold estimation.
common_regime_alert: COMMON_VOL_SHIFT OR XS_VOL_SHIFT_DISPERSION OR CORRELATION_BREAK exceeds its frozen threshold

evaluation.block_alert_fraction: fraction of evaluation timestamps whose causal alert is true
evaluation.common_failure_target: X5N block q95 turnover multiple versus slow
evaluation.association_metric: Spearman rank correlation across eight fixed blocks; descriptive only, no p-values

identifiability_gates.COMMON_REGIME_OBSERVABLE_IDENTIFIED: common alert fraction Spearman rho >= 0.60 with q95-turnover severity AND first structural block alert fraction >= 0.50
identifiability_gates.SSE50_CARRIER_REGIME_OBSERVABLE_IDENTIFI: carrier alert fraction Spearman rho >= 0.60 with 000016 ratio AND rho >= 0.60 with interaction-loss severity AND Mar-May alert fraction >= 0.50 AND Jun-Aug alert fraction < 0.50
